Name: A Very Special Blue Chicken
Author: andie301
Description:
Works with the current release of SDV. There is an issue where if you have an Auto-Grabber in the coops regardless of the percentage chance it will never lay a pearl and will only ever be eggs. I am currently working on a fix for that but it might take me a little while to fix this. I am also working on a way that you can enter a whole number for the percentage chance so that it is easier to use the config file. If you have any questions for me please feel free to message me and I will get back to you as soon as I can.

For Percentage chance you still enter a number between 0 and 1 where 0 is it will never lay a pearl and a 1 will always lay a pearl you can choose any number between, it still defaults to 0.1 (10%) but is easy to change. You can also choose how soon your chickens will start laying their pearls, enter a number between 1 and 5 respectively for their heart level with the farmer. I hope you all have fun with this mod. if you have any suggestions for this mod (although it is a pretty simple mod) please send me a message!
﻿
Older Files: Makes your Blue Chickens a little more special. If the player has enough hearts (3 hearts) with a blue chicken the chicken has the chance that it will lay a pearl instead of an egg. Also there is a config file that can increase the percentage chance, it defaults to 0.1 or 10% but can easily be changed.

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*](optional) If you want to change the chance that a pearl will be laid you can change the number in the config file. defaults to 0.1 or 10% but can be changed anywhere from 0.01 to 1.0, 1.0 being 100% of the time
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3 beta on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer. 
[*]This mod is currently not compatible with Deluxe Auto-Grabber as it will not pick up pearls but it still works for eggs.
[/list]
